learning_map_version_publication_time_ch.name: learning_map_version_publication_time_check
learning_map_version_publication_time_ch.value: ("learning_map_version"."status" = 'draft' AND "learning_map_version"."published_at" IS NULL) OR ("learning_map_version"."status" = 'published' AND "learning_map_version"."published_at" IS NOT NULL)

learning_assessment_question_set_publica.name: learning_assessment_question_set_publication_time_check
learning_assessment_question_set_publica.value: ("learning_assessment_question_set"."status" = 'draft' AND "learning_assessment_question_set"."published_at" IS NULL) OR ("learning_assessment_question_set"."status" = 'published' AND "learning_assessment_question_set"."published_at" IS NOT NULL)

learning_progress_node_completion_check.name: learning_progress_node_completion_check
learning_progress_node_completion_check.value: ("learning_progress_node"."completed_at" IS NULL AND "learning_progress_node"."best_score" < 8000) OR ("learning_progress_node"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "learning_progress_node"."best_score" >= 8000)

generation_task_result_consistency_check.name: generation_task_result_consistency_check
generation_task_result_consistency_check.value: (("generation_task"."status" = 'succeeded' AND "generation_task"."map_id" IS NOT NULL AND "generation_task"."version_id" IS NOT NULL AND "generation_task"."question_set_id" IS NOT NULL AND "generation_task"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("generation_task"."status" = 'failed' AND "generation_task"."map_id" IS NULL AND "generation_task"."version_id" IS NULL AND "generation_task"."question_set_id" IS NULL AND "generation_task"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL) OR ("generation_task"."status" NOT IN ('succeeded', 'failed') AND "generation_task"."map_id" IS NULL AND "generation_task"."version_id" IS NULL AND "generation_task"."question_set_id" IS NULL AND "generation_task"."completed_at" IS NULL))

generation_task_failure_consistency_chec.name: generation_task_failure_consistency_check
generation_task_failure_consistency_chec.value: ("generation_task"."status" = 'failed' AND "generation_task"."failure_code" IS NOT NULL AND "generation_task"."failure_retryable" IS NOT NULL) OR ("generation_task"."status" <> 'failed' AND "generation_task"."failure_code" IS NULL AND "generation_task"."failure_retryable" IS NULL)
